prs.location:
Brickfield Square is ideally located in Dublin 12, offering the perfect balance between a peaceful residential community and easy access to Dublin city centre, hospitals, universities, shopping and some of the city’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.

Just minutes from Dublin 8, Rialto and Inchicore, residents can enjoy an ever-growing selection of cafés, restaurants, independent shops and local amenities. Inchicore was named one of the 50 coolest neighbourhoods in the world by Time Out in 2025, recognised for its authentic character, creative scene and strong sense of community.

With Dublin city centre approximately 3km away, Brickfield Square offers the convenience of city living while maintaining the comfort of a residential setting.

MAJOR HOSPITALS & HEALTHCARE FACILITIES NEARBY

Another significant advantage of the location is its proximity to some of Dublin’s most important healthcare facilities.

St James’s Hospital, The Coombe Hospital and Children’s Health Ireland at Crumlin are all nearby, while Tallaght University Hospital is easily accessible via the Luas Red Line.

Having several of Dublin’s leading healthcare facilities nearby adds another level of convenience to Brickfield Square’s well-connected location.

EXCELLENT TRANSPORT CONNECTIONS

Getting around Dublin is easy from Brickfield Square.

The Suir Road Luas stop on the Red Line is approximately a 10-minute walk away, providing convenient connections to St James’s Hospital, Heuston Station, the city centre, the Docklands and Tallaght.

The area is also well served by Dublin Bus, offering convenient connections across the city for everyday travel, education and leisure.

For those travelling by car, convenient access to the N7 and M50 makes travelling across Dublin or heading outside the city straightforward.

SHOPPING, DINING & EVERYDAY CONVENIENCE

Everything you need for everyday living is within easy reach.

The surrounding neighbourhoods of Rialto, Inchicore and Dublin 8 offer local cafés, bakeries, restaurants, shops and services, while Ashleaf Shopping Centre provides convenient access to supermarkets and everyday retail.

For even more choice, Dublin city centre and St Stephen’s Green are only a short journey away, putting some of the city’s best shopping, dining, entertainment and cultural attractions within easy reach.

WELL POSITIONED FOR DUBLIN LIFE

Brickfield Square provides a well-connected base with convenient access to Dublin city centre, major healthcare facilities, educational institutions and local amenities. Dedicated shared workspace and meeting areas within the development provide residents with additional flexibility as part of the onsite amenity offering.

With excellent public transport, easy road connections, major hospitals nearby and Dublin city centre just a few kilometres away, Brickfield Square puts residents close to key destinations while providing a comfortable community to come home to.

Brickfield Square - Award-Winning Living • Exceptional Amenities • Professionally Managed by Greystar

GET FREE WI-FI FOR 6 MONTHS WHEN YOU MOVE IN!

At Brickfield Square, your rent gives you more than a beautifully designed apartment.
It gives you access to an entire lifestyle: your gym, workspace, residents' lounge, games room, private dining, pet spa, landscaped gardens, community spaces and dedicated onsite team, all within one professionally managed development.

Located just 3km from Dublin City Centre, Brickfield Square offers modern rental living for residents who value quality, convenience, service and community.


Residents enjoy access to an exceptional collection of onsite amenities:

• Modern co-working spaces & private meeting rooms

Make the most of dedicated co-working spaces without relying on your kitchen table. Fit in a workout without travelling across the city. Meet neighbours at resident events or simply relax in beautifully maintained shared spaces.

Depending on apartment type and layout, homes feature:

At Brickfield Square, you're choosing your home, gym, workspace, resident amenities, community and onsite support — together in one professionally managed development.

Arrange a private viewing with our Leasing Team and experience Brickfield Square for yourself.
